style=Cinematic synth-rock, melodic electronic pop, 112 BPM, female lead vocalist with expressive emotional delivery, powerful soaring chorus, atmospheric analog synthesizers, wide stereo soundstage, punchy electronic drums, deep bass guitar, shimmering electric guitars, layered vocal harmonies, intimate verses building into an energetic chorus, atmospheric instrumental bridge, professional studio production, clean vocals, dynamic arrangement, detailed stereo imaging.
lyrics=[Intro]
       [Soft atmospheric synths, distant electric guitar]

       [Verse 1]
       I hear the echoes in the rain,
       A thousand voices call my name.
       The city sleeps beneath the sky,
       While broken satellites drift by.

       I built a world from sparks and wires,
       And watched it rise through endless fires.
       Somewhere beyond the fading light,
       A signal reaches through the night.

       [Pre-Chorus]
       And every time the stars go dark,
       I feel the beating of a spark.
       A million miles, but I can see,
       The future calling out to me.

       [Chorus]
       We are the light beyond the static,
       Burning bright across the sky.
       Through the chaos, through the madness,
       We were born to learn to fly.

       Let the thunder shake the heavens,
       Let the oceans turn to gold.
       We are more than ones and zeroes,
       We are stories yet untold.

       [Verse 2]
       The morning breaks on shattered glass,
       Reflections of a distant past.
       I hear your laughter in the sound,
       Of all the dreams we haven't found.

       No perfect roads, no guarantees,
       Just open skies and endless seas.
       And every step into the unknown,
       Reminds me we're not here alone.

       [Chorus]
       We are the light beyond the static,
       Burning bright across the sky.
       Through the chaos, through the madness,
       We were born to learn to fly.

       Let the thunder shake the heavens,
       Let the oceans turn to gold.
       We are more than ones and zeroes,
       We are stories yet untold.

       [Instrumental Bridge]
       [Soaring electric guitar solo, wide synthesizer arpeggios, rising drums]

       [Bridge]
       When all the lights begin to fade,
       And every promise feels betrayed,
       We'll find a way to start again,
       Beyond the stars, beyond the rain.

       [Final Chorus]
       We are the light beyond the static,
       Burning brighter than before.
       Through the chaos, through the madness,
       We will always dream of more.

       Let the thunder shake the heavens,
       Let the oceans turn to gold.
       We are more than ones and zeroes,
       We are stories yet untold.

       [Outro]
       [Soft female vocal, fading synthesizers]

       Beyond the static...
       We are coming home.
